summary: KB Editor Table Drag-and-Drop Row Reordering - All 13 features tested and verified. Table insertion works via Insert menu. Grip handles appear on data rows only (not header). Context menu with all 6 actions works correctly. Drag-and-drop reordering with visual feedback (drag-source-highlight and drop-indicator) fully functional. Row content correctly moves to new position after drag.
critical_code_review_comments: TableMenu.jsx is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Drag threshold of 5px correctly distinguishes click from drag operations
Visual feedback during drag (drag-source-highlight and drop-indicator) works correctly
Row reorder logic using ProseMirror transactions is correctly implemented
Context menu actions (Insert before/after, Move up/down, Copy row, Delete row) all functional
seed_data_creation: None required - tested with new table creation
context_for_next_testing_agent: KB Editor table drag-and-drop row reordering fully implemented and tested. Table can be inserted via Insert menu (data-testid='insert-table'). Grip handles (data-testid='table-row-grip-{index}') appear on data rows only (not header row index 0). Click on grip opens context menu (data-testid='table-row-context-menu') with 6 actions. Drag operation starts after 5px vertical movement, shows drag-source-highlight and drop-indicator. Releasing mouse reorders rows correctly.

table_insertion_via_insert_menu.details: Click Insert → Table inserts 3x3 table (1 header + 2 data rows)

grip_handles_on_data_rows.details: data-testid='table-row-grip-1' and 'table-row-grip-2' visible when cursor in table

context_menu_has_6_actions.details: Insert before, Insert after, Move up, Move down, Copy row, Delete row all present

move_down_action.details: data-testid='table-row-moveDown' moves row one position down

move_up_action.details: data-testid='table-row-moveUp' moves row one position up

copy_row_action.details: data-testid='table-row-copyRow' duplicates row (row count increases by 1)

insert_before_action.details: data-testid='table-row-insertBefore' adds new empty row before current

insert_after_action.details: data-testid='table-row-insertAfter' adds new empty row after current

delete_row_action.details: data-testid='table-row-deleteRow' removes current row (row count decreases by 1)

drag_visual_indicators.details: data-testid='drag-source-highlight' and 'drop-indicator' appear during drag (after >5px movement)

drag_reorder_rows.details: Releasing mouse at different row position reorders table rows correctly

row_content_moves_correctly.details: Verified FIRST_ROW and SECOND_ROW swapped positions after drag

mocked_apis_list: /api/auth/me - mocked with 200 and user JSON for auth bypass
